selection.population: mock-observed galaxies: selected by effective surface brightness with the HSC-SSP completeness and an r-band cut of 26 mag, Sandage-Tammann-Yahil estimator
selection.warning: Thick purple dotted line of Dubois et al. 2021 (z=0.25 panel): the NewHorizon mass function constructed with the Sandage-Tammann-Yahil (STY) method after applying a surface-brightness selection that mimics the HSC-SSP deep layer and an r < 26 cut (masses from LePhare SED fits of dust-attenuated mock g, r, i, z magnitudes of HOP galaxies, with the knee fixed). It is a mock-observed estimator, not the binned count of the raw simulation, so it is kept as its own run and should be compared with survey mass functions rather than with the binned curves. No table exists. The line is a coarse polyline whose vertices sit on a 0.1 dex grid (24 inside the plotted range); its first vertex lies left of the plot (log M about 5.95), so the stretch from the left edge of the plot to log M = 8.3 is not recorded. The HSC-SSP curve it is compared with is not extracted.
